title.narrative: Support for Health Infrastructure in Brazil

description.narrative: This project is to provide project management service to EBSERH (Brazilian Enterprise of Federal Hospitals) to support the public institution to build 7 Federal University Hospitals (Hospitais Universitários Federais - HUFs). Seven states in the North of Brazil, namely Acre, Roraima, Rondônia, Amapá, Paraíba,Tocantins and Mato Grosso do Sul do not have coverage of HUFs to provide research, training and health care to the population. Specifically UNOPS engagement focuses on the provision of project management services for the project design stage followed by potential supervision (only) of construction phase which will be implemented by EBSERH.
